title: Roof Replacement in Edinburg, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Roof replacement in Edinburg, TX from a roofer based in Edinburg. Hail damaged and aging shingle roofs, full tear off, written scope. Call (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction is based in Edinburg, on N Jackson Rd. We replace hail damaged and worn out shingle roofs across the city with a full tear off and a written scope.

sections.title: A roofer based in Edinburg
paras: Our office is at 1815 N Jackson Rd, so an Edinburg roof is a short drive for us. We have been replacing roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003.

Edinburg's homes split into two groups. About 30% were built before 1990, and more than half went up in 2000 or later, according to Census survey data (ACS 2024). The median home dates to 2002. Older homes are often on their second or third roof. Many of the newer ones still have the roof the builder put on, and those first roofs are now 20 years old or close to it. The city keeps growing too: 32 new subdivisions with 867 lots were approved in 2025, and 45 more were under review in 2026, according to Valley Business Report.
About half of Edinburg homes are renter occupied (ACS 2024). If you own a rental, a written roof scope and invoice are useful for your insurer and your records.

sections.title: Hail keeps hitting Edinburg
paras: NOAA storm records show how often hail has hit Edinburg lately. On June 4, 2023, hail 1 inch across was reported. On May 13, 2024, hail up to 1.75 inches fell near Faysville. On May 8, 2025, hail up to 1.75 inches hit south Edinburg and 2 inch hail was reported near Dove Ave and McColl Rd. A few weeks earlier in 2023, about 65 mph winds on April 28 brought down a gas station canopy at Lark Ave and N 23rd St.

After the April 2023 storm and again in April 2025, the city waived roofing permit fees for storm repairs. If your roof took hail in one of these storms and it was never checked, the damage may be worse than it looks from the ground. Hail bruises can lose granules for months before a leak shows up. A free inspection after a storm gives you a written record of the roof's condition on that date, which helps if you file a claim later.

sections.title: What goes into an Edinburg roof replacement

cards.title: Tear off to the deck
cards.body: The old shingles and underlayment come off so we can see the decking. Nothing goes over an old roof.

cards.title: Decking repairs
cards.body: Rotted or water damaged boards are replaced and listed on your invoice.

cards.title: Your choice of shingle
cards.body: CertainTeed, Owens Corning, or GAF. We are the only CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster in the Valley.

cards.title: Vents and flashing
cards.body: New flashing at walls and valleys, and attic ventilation checked so heat does not build up under the new roof.

cards.title: Insurance paperwork
cards.body: When a claim is paying for the roof, we document what we found with photos so you know what to show your insurer.

cards.title: Written paperwork
cards.body: Scope, price, and timeline before work, and the finished invoice after.

sections.title: Permits and insurance in Edinburg
paras: Edinburg has adopted the 2018 International Residential Code. Building Safety is at 415 W University Dr, (956) 388-8203, if you want to ask about permits for your address.

If you are filing a claim, the Texas Department of Insurance suggests getting more than one bid, and it is illegal in Texas for a contractor to waive your deductible. We put our findings in writing with photos so you can show your insurer. For the full process, read our roof replacement guide for Edinburg, and if a repair might be enough, see roof repair in Edinburg.

faqs.q: My roof took hail in 2024 or 2025. Is it too late to check it?
faqs.a: No. Get it inspected now. Hail damage keeps getting worse after the storm, and your policy may have a time limit for filing, so check with your insurer about yours.

faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost in Edinburg?
faqs.a: For a typical Edinburg home, a full shingle replacement generally runs between $8,000 and $18,000, depending on size, pitch, and the shingle you choose. The written estimate comes first.
Most Edinburg homes take one to three days, weather permitting. You get the timeline in writing before we start.

faqs.q: Can you replace my gutters at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. Doing the gutters with the roof means one crew and no redoing fascia or trim work twice. See gutters in Edinburg.

faqs.q: Do you install new roofs on new construction?
faqs.a: Yes, we roof new builds and additions and coordinate with the builder or general contractor.

faqs.q: How do I get an estimate?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We are in Edinburg, and estimates are free.
